question: Six years ago, the ratio of A and B was 7 ∶ 8. After 2 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 9 ∶ 10. What is the sum of the present ages (in years) of A and B?
solution:
Given:

Six years ago, the ratio of A and B was 7 ∶ 8. After 2 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 9 ∶ 10.

Calculation:

Let the age of A and B six years ago be 7Q and 8Q respectively.

Presents ages of A and B are (7Q + 6) and (8Q + 6) respectively.

According to the question,

(7Q + 6 + 2)/ (8Q + 6 + 2) = 9/10

⇒ 10 &a
